name: Tooltips live in a TooltipArea wrapper, not in the application
body:
# Tooltips live in a TooltipArea wrapper, not in the application

Dean (2026-11-05) moved IconButton's tooltip state into the component (`apps/world-editor/src/ui/IconButton.chaos`, caf3eb9) as an example of how components should be written: a component's functions stay with it, and `EditorApplication` doesn't collect behaviour that doesn't belong to it. That broke the tooltip, because the delay and the drawing still live in `EditorApplication` (`ShowTooltip`, `HideTooltip`, `PollTooltip` and five tooltip fields) and `App.chaos`.

It needs Chaos components to take children (Chaos board: "A component can't take children, so a wrapper component can't share behaviour"). One-at-a-time and dismiss-on-menu need context ("Components have no context, so app-wide services are reached through the application").

comments.text: Done 2026-11-05 (lantern #48, with Chaos component children in chaos-ui-framework #3 and penumbra-bridge #7's root-child lifecycle fix). No portal and no stored position: the bubble is positioned by Cosmos (`.tooltip`, `.tooltip-end`, `.tooltip-inside` in MenuBar.cosmos), so the old window-width clamp is replaced by the `end` placement for controls near a right edge. Hover exclusivity already means one tooltip shows at a time; the tooltip service is the follow-up card 'One tooltip at a time through a context service'.

plan:
1. `TooltipArea` component (`src/ui/TooltipArea.chaos`): props `text`, `placement` and `children`, `@signal` locals for hovering, the hover time and whether the bubble shows, and an `OnTick` local for the 0.45 s delay. The bubble is an absolutely positioned, pointer-events-none frame under the control (`placement` `below`, `end` for controls near a right edge, or `inside` for asset cards), not a `<portal>`: any open portal takes the root's hover, so a portal tooltip flickered.
2. `IconButton` (with a `tooltipPlacement` prop, `end` for the toolbar's right-hand group), `AssetCard` and `InspectorField`'s remove button wrap themselves in it.
3. Remove the tooltip fields and methods from `EditorApplication`, and `Tooltip.chaos` plus its slot from `App.chaos`.
4. One tooltip at a time and menus hiding it moved to its own card, now that Chaos has `@provide`/`@context`.
acceptance_criteria: Hovering a toolbar button, an asset card or the remove-property button shows the tooltip after the delay, and leaving hides it.
EditorApplication has no tooltip state or methods.
definition_of_done: Screenshot of a tooltip in the chat
